{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the 'status' column has only 'completed' and 'refunded'
assert set(sales_df['status'].unique()) == {'completed', 'refunded'}, "Unexpected status values"

# Count orders that were actually completed (not refunded)
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Verify total count matches
assert completed_orders + sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0] == len(sales_df), "Total orders don't add up"

completed_orders"}
